content_flow.text: The BDes full form is Bachelor of Design . It is one of the most popular Design Courses and is a 4-year UG course that can be studied in various specialisations. The B Design course strongly focuses on the creative and design principles, where students get to work in dedicated studio spaces, gather design skills, and learn many methods and techniques to get better.

B.Des Degree is available in multiple specialisations like Fashion Design, Graphic Design, Interior Design, Product Design, Textile Design, Jewellery Design, Game Design, etc. Students get to learn skills like creativity, problem-solving, and industry-specific knowledge about Design.

There are many Career options from which a B.Des Graduate can choose to pursue and get job roles in the fast-growing design industry. After B.Des students can become Fashion Designer, Graphic Designer, UI/UX Designer, Textile Designer, Product Designer, Industrial Designer, and Art Director and earn anywhere from INR 4 LPA to INR 15 LPA and even more with experience.
Students who are interested in pursuing B.Des Course can read the article further.

faqs.question: What are the benefits of pursuing BDes in Fashion Designing?
faqs.answer: The Fashion Designing stream is a very popular stream with multiple employment opportunities. Since BDes Fashion Design is an important course in this field, so the demand for this course is high. We have discussed some advantages of this course below. Demand for this course will never decrease in the job market: As new fashion trends and clothing styles keep on evolving, the demand for fashion designers will always be high. High Starting Salary: The candidates with BDes Fashion Design will get a starting salary in the range of INR 4,00,000 to 5,00,000, which is quite good for a fresher with no experience. faqs.question: What do we learn in the first year of BDes?
faqs.answer: When you join a BDes programme, you learn about the fundamental concepts of Design in the first year. You would not be expected to have any previous knowledge or background in the field of Design. In many colleges the first semester is common for all BDes specialisations. You would learn subjects like Introduction to Design,  Elements of Design,  Creative Visualization Techniques,  Design Drawing,  Design Thinking,  Principles of Design,  Physical Ergonomics and Rendering & Illustration.

content_flow.text: BDes is a four-year bachelor's degree programme at the undergraduate level that focuses on the theoretical design process, furniture design, interior decorating, graphic design, and culinary design. This course intends to provide in-depth design knowledge in order to develop a reservoir of research personnel with design skills. BDes graduates can find a plethora of job options and work as fashion designer, graphic designer, Art Director, Design Manager, and so on. The BDes syllabus focuses on developing intellectual creativity as well as technical abilities among students who wish to enter the various design industries.
Some of the important facts related to BDes course are:

Advantages: According to several news organisations, the Indian Fashion Industry is predicted to grow at a rate of 10-12% in the next years, opening up opportunities for growth as well as diverse career possibilities. Also, hundreds of new brands are expected to open new stores by 2023, highlighting the enormous possibilities of expansion. Students can also start their businesses, which could be fashion designing or creating their own consultancy.

Admissions: Candidates must have a decent grade point average in their higher secondary level from a recognised college. At the time of admission to a good college, aspiring students should have a work/design portfolio available.

Students who have received high results in either of the entrance tests can gain admission to a good college. Because there are fewer places available for BDes students in government colleges, the higher the scores, the better the prospects of admission to premier institutes such as NIFT, NID, IIT-IDC, MITID, and others.

Scope: Students can pursue MDes after completing BDes. It is a two-year post graduate course that trains the candidates in the disciplines of User Experience & Interaction Design, Industrial Design, and Visual Communication, etc . The MDes curriculum is divided into four semesters. The first three focus on theoretical themes, while the final focuses on internship or industrial dissertation. Admission to these programmes is based on entrance tests such as NIFT, IICD, CEED, and so on.

Fees: BDes course can be completed from the prestigious National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT) at a cost varying from INR 6 to INR 7 lakhs and from Pearl Academy in Delhi at an estimated cost of INR 10 lakhs. However, the fees structure varies from college to college and type of specialisation taken.

The curriculum has been created by industry experts in a manner that students gain deep understanding about the Designing subjects that can help them in shaping their careers. The BDes course curriculum varies by speciality, but the structure of the course is consistent, consisting of basic subjects, learning strategies, and projects with industrial exposure.

content_flow.text: B.Des full form is a Bachelor of Design course which is a 4-year undergraduate degree program in the field of Design. The career scope of BDes is as vast as its specializations . A Bachelor of Design course and career can be pursued in various specializations like Fashion Design, Interior Design, Product/Industrial Design, UI/XU Design, Graphic Design, Textile Design, Web Design , and so on.

BDes is one of the most sought-after courses in the field of Design and students can seek various employment opportunities after completing the BDes program from their specific specializations. For instance, students completing a BDes in Fashion Design can pursue their career in Fashion Retail, Cloth Manufacturing, Media & Entertainment, Digital Marketing , etc., industries.

jobs after BDes are completely based on the specialization chosen by the graduates. However, some of the popular job profiles BDes graduates seek are Fashion Designer, Interior Designer, Footwear Designer, UI Designer, Textile Designer, Web Designer , etc. The average salary of BDes graduates can vary depending on their relevant experience, skills, portfolio, geographical location, recruiters , etc.

However, the average salary of a Fashion Designer is INR 4.3 LPA in India . Many BDes colleges in India also provide great placement opportunities such as IITs, Vijaybhoomi University, Punjab Engineering College, ITM University, Universal AI University, KIIT School of Fashion Technology , etc. Interested candidates can continue reading the article for more BDes Career Scope details.

BDes Career Scope: Top Job Profiles

A BDes course serves as a gateway to many creative positions in the field of Design and related fields. Bdes graduates can seek creative and highly rewarding employment opportunities in India and across the globe. Here are some top job profiles along with job and average Bachelor of Design salary details.

rows: A Fashion Designer follows the latest trends and designs clothes and accessories following the trends. They work on cloth material, analyze market demand, collaborate with design teams and workers, etc.

They create plans for spaces to be secure, functional, and efficient. They understand the requirements of the clients and ensure that the design meets those needs. They also ensure that the design complies with the property's codes and regulations.
As the name suggests, a Textile Designer designs textiles blending the colours, textures, and patterns in their own unique way. They work on clients' needs and technical staff to develop designs.

A UI (User Interface) Designer creates all the designs users see while going through the app or website. Meanwhile, a UX (User Experience) Designer works on the user experience by working on the product function, usability, etc.
Their job is to create products based on the client's or company's requirements. First, they map out drawings and then design a fully functional product.
Graphic Designers create visually appealing texts and images. They design creative content including illustrations, logos, layouts and photos for social media advertising, branding, etc.
Jewellery Designers design modern and ethnic accessories following the latest trends. They work on various precious metals and stones like Gold, Diamond, Platinum, and Silver.

A Web Designer creates the layout of a website and designs its aesthetics. They use programming languages like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, etc., and ensure that the sites are both technically sound while meeting the user's needs.
